profile.headline: SCADA Engineer 3 @ BHE GT&S
profile.summary:
I have worked in the O&G Industry since 2007. I am blessed to be working as an engineer to support SCADA operations. Also, I have field and supervisor experience in Upstream Operations (Drilling, Completions, and Production).

I graduated from West Virginia University with a B.S. in Computer Engineering. I have completed two graduate level courses in Petroleum Engineering from Texas A&M.

positions.title: Independent Petroleum Consultant
positions.description: Drilling/Well Site Consultant in the Marcellus Shale and Utica Shale. Performed work for EOG Resources, Halcon Resources, SWN Energy, Trans Energy/Republic Energy, Arrington O&G.

positions.title: Drilling Engineer/Well Site Supervisor
positions.description: I supervised daily operations on shale and conventional gas drilling sites. I worked in WV, PA, VA, and TN.

positions.title: Surface Data Logger (Mud Logger)
positions.description: I worked offshore in the Gulf of Mexico. I was a Surface Data Logger in the Sperry Drilling PSL of Halliburton. I mainly did work for Chevron in the deep-water blocks off the coast of Louisiana.
